$comment: The update law, as data. Enforced by tools/check_canonical_sync.py at two points:
the local pre-commit hook (tools/githooks/pre-commit) and the CI job
'Canonical law - read receipt, roadmap order, update law'.
RULE: if a commit touches any substantive_globs path (and no exempt_globs path covers
it), that same commit must also touch EVERY required_docs entry. Not 'any one of them'
- every one. tools/check_coordination.py already accepts any single state file at PR
level; that stays true and is not weakened here. This gate is the stricter, per-commit
reading of the Owner's standing rule, and it has no environment bypass.
tools/* and .github/* are IN scope here although check_coordination.py excludes them.
That exclusion is why a gate could be added, or silently stop being run, without any
document mentioning it - which is how tools/check_i18n_parity.py came to be executed by
Widening substantive_globs makes the law stricter. Narrowing it, or shortening
required_docs, makes the law weaker and is exactly the edit a reviewer should look for:
it lands in the diff of the commit that wants the exemption.
